collection.title: Vauxhall Crossland/Crossland X 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Vauxhall Crossland X 2017 Onwards model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Slim Push Button arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this Crossland, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.

image.alt: Vauxhall Crossland/Crossland X 2017 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
